meta.name: archify
meta.description: Create polished, validated architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle/state diagrams as explorable standalone HTML with inline SVG, dark/light themes, optional trace motion, and PNG/JPEG/WebP/SVG/WebM export. Accept plain-language requirements or pasted Mermaid flowchart, sequenceDiagram, and stateDiagram input; inspect repository evidence when the diagram must reflect real code. Use when the user asks to visualize system architecture, infrastructure, cloud/security/network topology, technical workflows, API call sequences, request lifecycles, data pipelines, ETL/ELT, data lineage, state machines, or to convert/beautify Mermaid.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把系统结构与流程变成清晰直观的图表
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 需要把系统结构画出来给团队评审或留档。
copy.tagline_en: Turn system structures and flows into clear diagrams
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to visualize system structure for team review or documentation.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把你要画的系统架构、流程、时序、数据流或状态图,做成一个可交互的独立 HTML 文件,内嵌 SVG,支持深色/浅色主题,还能导出 PNG、SVG 等格式。
howto.when: 当你用大白话描述架构、工作流、接口调用等,或直接粘贴 Mermaid 的流程图、时序图、状态图时触发;涉及真实代码时会去仓库查证据。

say.text: 帮我把这段 Mermaid 流程图变成好看的 HTML 图
say.note: 会先读取 Mermaid 拓扑,再生成 Archify 图

say.text: 画一个用户登录的时序图,要暗色主题

say.text: 把这个 API 调用过程画成序列图

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude turns your described architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, or lifecycle diagram into a standalone interactive HTML with inline SVG, dark/light themes, and export to PNG, SVG, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you describe such diagrams in plain language, or paste Mermaid flowchart/sequence/state diagrams; it inspects repository evidence when real code is involved.

say_en.text: Turn this Mermaid flowchart into a clean HTML diagram.
say_en.note: It reads the Mermaid topology, then authors a fresh Archify diagram.

say_en.text: Draw a dark-themed sequence diagram for user login.
say_en.note: Produces explorable HTML with theme toggle and image export.

say_en.text: Visualize this API call chain as a sequence diagram.
say_en.note: Uses sequence type with semantic participants.
